title: Sheaf-map comparison after underlying-map equality
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $L$ an invertible $X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and $S$ its graded section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring]. Let $d,e>0$, $s\in S_d$, $t\in S_e$, and opens $U,V\subseteq X$ with underlying sets respectively the nonvanishing loci of $s,t$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Suppose given morphisms $g:U\to\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ and $h:V\to\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-pc-proj]. For each of these morphisms $k$, assume that for every positive-degree homogeneous $a\in S_r$, every $n\geq0$, and every $\xi\in S_{nr}$, on the ambient image $W$ of $k^{-1}(D_+(a))$ its scalar pullback satisfies $k^\sharp(\xi/a^n)\cdot(a^n)|_W=\xi|_W$. Suppose in addition that the underlying continuous maps of $F=g|_{U\cap V}$ and $H=h|_{U\cap V}$ are identified by an equality $b$. For every open $W\subseteq\operatorname{Proj}(S)$, the ring homomorphisms $F^\sharp_W$ and $H^\sharp_W$ agree after transporting along the equality $F^{-1}(W)=H^{-1}(W)$ induced by $b$.

proof.text: For a positive homogeneous chart a, use sectionRing_chart_denominator_generator on its common inverse image inside U intersect V. Equality of underlying maps identifies the inverse images. Restrict the original g and h fraction equations to this ambient open using presheaf functoriality and compatibility with scalar multiplication.

Cancel the free generator a^n in the two restricted equations. Away.mk_surjective expresses every element of the degree-zero homogeneous localization as xi/a^n, including the empty-chart case. The isomorphism basicOpenIsoAway makes awayToSection an epimorphism, so equality on all fractions gives equality of appLE maps. Using resLE_app_top and ext_of_isAffine proves equality of the restricted morphisms into D_+(a).

Proj.affineOpenCover supplies a positive homogeneous chart at each image point. Apply Scheme.hom_ext_of_forall to the inverse images of these charts. Finally Scheme.Hom.congr_app gives equality on every target open; composition of eqToHom restrictions cancels the transport against its inverse.

theorem sectionRing_overlap_sheaf_map
    (X : Scheme.{v}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (d e : ℕ) (s : sectionRingGrade L d) (t : sectionRingGrade L e)
    (hd : 0 < d) (he : 0 < e) (U V : X.Opens)
    (hU : (U : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus (L.tensorPow d) (s.val d))
    (hV : (V : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus (L.tensorPow e) (t.val e))
    (g : U.toScheme ⟶ Proj (sectionRingGrade L))
    (h : V.toScheme ⟶ Proj (sectionRingGrade L))
    (hg : ∀ (e : ℕ) (_he : 0 < e) (t : sectionRingGrade L e)
          (n : ℕ) (ξ : sectionRingGrade L (n • e)),
          (show Γ(X, U.ι ''ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ
              Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val)) from
            g.app (Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val)
            (Proj.awayToSection (sectionRingGrade L) t.val
              (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (sectionRingGrade L) t.property n
                ξ.val ξ.property))) •
            (L.tensorPow (n • e)).presheaf.map (homOfLE
              (le_top : U.ι ''ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val) ≤
                ⊤)).op ((t.val ^ n) (n • e)) =
          (L.tensorPow (n • e)).presheaf.map (homOfLE
            (le_top : U.ι ''ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val) ≤
              ⊤)).op (ξ.val (n • e)))
    (hh : ∀ (e : ℕ) (_he : 0 < e) (t : sectionRingGrade L e)
          (n : ℕ) (ξ : sectionRingGrade L (n • e)),
          (show Γ(X, V.ι ''ᵁ (h ⁻¹ᵁ
              Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val)) from
            h.app (Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val)
            (Proj.awayToSection (sectionRingGrade L) t.val
              (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (sectionRingGrade L) t.property n
                ξ.val ξ.property))) •
            (L.tensorPow (n • e)).presheaf.map (homOfLE
              (le_top : V.ι ''ᵁ (h ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val) ≤
                ⊤)).op ((t.val ^ n) (n • e)) =
          (L.tensorPow (n • e)).presheaf.map (homOfLE
            (le_top : V.ι ''ᵁ (h ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val) ≤
              ⊤)).op (ξ.val (n • e)))
    (hbase : (X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U) ≫ g).base =
      (X.homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V) ≫ h).base) :
    ∀ W, (X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U) ≫ g).app W ≫
      (U ⊓ V).toScheme.presheaf.map
        (eqToHom congr((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map $hbase.symm).obj W)).op =
      (X.homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V) ≫ h).app W
